content_sections.heading: About Jayashankar Bhupalpally Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Government of Telangana permission for 333 service categories across the state was given in G.O.Rt.No.1508, Fin (HRM.VII) Dept., Dt:21/08/2026. These comprise 38 services on contract and 295 services on outsourcing basis. Following that order, the Director, Department of AYUSH, T.G., Secunderabad, asked the Collector and District Magistrate, Jayashankar Bhupalpally District, to fill only the 10 posts sanctioned for this district through the District Selection Committee (DSC). The posts are meant exclusively for the AYUSH Department under the Public Health Programme in the National AYUSH Mission. Selected candidates will work under the administrative control of the Director, Department of AYUSH, T.G., Secunderabad.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: All 10 posts are in Jayashankar Bhupalpally District. The notice gives the following post-wise count with roster points: In the roster, seven points are OC, two are SC (Group.II) and one is BC-A. For the Psychosocial Counselor post, the notice adds that a panel of eligible candidates may be empaneled and engaged on a call basis as and when their services are required. content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: The notice does not ask for work experience for any of the posts. The full qualification for each post, as printed, is given below. Must possess a Degree in Ayurveda or Unani or Homoeopathy or Naturopathy system. The degree must be awarded by a University in India established or incorporated by or under a Central Act, State Act or Provincial Act, by an institution recognized by the University Grants Commission, or by any statutory Board of the State Government. The candidate must have completed a regular course of institutional study in the respective system, in both theory and practice. That course must last not less than 4 ½ years, in a teaching institution recognized by the university or state government, with one year compulsory internship. Must possess any of the following qualifications: D Pharmacy, B Pharmacy or Pharma D. Must be registered with the Telangana Pharmacy Council. Must possess a Post Graduate Degree in Master of Social Work (MSW). The degree must be awarded by a University in India established or incorporated by or under a Central Act, or by an Institution recognized by the University Grants Commission. Must possess any of the following qualifications: A Degree in Naturopathy system awarded by a University in India established or incorporated by or under a Central Act, State Act or Provincial Act, an institution recognized by the University Grants Commission, or any statutory Board of the State Government. The degree must follow a regular course of institutional study, in theory and practice, of not less than 4 ½ years in a recognized teaching institution, with one year compulsory internship. OR a 'Diploma in Naturopathy and Yogic Sciences' awarded by a University in India established or incorporated by or under a Central Act, State Act or Provincial Act, an institution recognized by the University Grants Commission, or any statutory Board of the State Government. Must have passed VII Class examination. Must be able to ride a Bicycle / Motorcycle. The notice also states that the remuneration and educational qualifications for each category shall be as specified in the approved guidelines and Government Orders. Candidates should check the official notification for the exact eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit and Relaxation
content_sections.text: For all posts, the minimum age is 18 years and the maximum age is 44 years, both reckoned as on 01/07/2026. The following relaxations apply to the maximum age limit as per rules:

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The pay is consolidated, and the notice names no allowances. The terms printed in the notice are: The engagement is on an outsourcing basis up to 31.03.2027. After that, the services will continue as per need and subject to satisfactory performance. Staff will work under AYUSH Public Health Programmes in Jayashankar Bhupalpally District, under the administrative control of the Director, Department of AYUSH, T.G., Secunderabad. content_sections.heading: Reservation and Unit of Appointment
content_sections.text: Rules of Reservation for Community, Disability and Ex-service Men will be strictly observed as per the Telangana State and Subordinate Service Rules, 1996, read with the relevant Specific Rules applicable. Reservation for local candidates applies as per the Presidential Order.

rows.unit_of_appointment: Can apply in any District in the concerned Multi Zone, but selection shall be restricted to one District

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The District Selection Committee of the District Health Society makes the selection on a total of 100 marks. Ninety marks come from the qualifying examination, or from a written test for MPW, and ten marks are given for age. The steps are described below. AYUSH Medical Officer, Pharmacist, Psychosocial Counselor and Yoga Professional: 90 marks based on the marks obtained in the qualifying examination. Multi Purpose Worker: 90 marks for a written test conducted by the concerned authorities. The notice does not give the test date, syllabus or pattern. Age weightage applies to all posts and is counted from 18 years of age. A candidate gets 0.5 mark for each completed year, up to a maximum of 10 marks, with age reckoned as on 1.7.2026. The notice gives these examples: 20 years completed as on 1.7.2026: 1.0 mark. 30 years completed as on 1.7.2026: 6.0 marks. 40 years completed as on 1.7.2026: 10.0 marks. A merit list will be prepared from these marks and displayed on the website for transparency. The selection list will be prepared from the finalised merit list, following the rule of reservation and the Presidential Order. For Psychosocial Counselor, a panel of eligible candidates may be empaneled.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Jayashankar Bhupalpally Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications are offline only, and the application window was open as of 30 October 2026. Applications must reach the office by 31 October 2026. Those received after the due date will be summarily rejected, and the District Selection Committee is not responsible for postal delays. Download the application form and instructions from the official website of Jayashankar Bhupalpally District. Fill in the application form and paste one photograph on it. Enclose self-attested copies of the certificates listed below. Submit the application in person or by registered post to: IDOC, Room No:G5, Ground Floor, O/o. the Collector & District Magistrate, Jayashankar Bhupalpally District. Applications are received from 23/10/2026 to 31/10/2026, between 10:30 AM and 05:00 PM, on working days.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in Jayashankar Bhupalpally Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 10 posts: AYUSH Medical Officer (4), Pharmacist (1), Psychosocial Counselor (1), Yoga Professional (1) and Multi Purpose Worker (MPW) (3).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the IDOC by 31 October 2026, between 10:30 AM and 05:00 PM. Applications received after the due date will be summarily rejected.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the Multi Purpose Worker post?
faq.answer: The candidate must have passed the VII Class examination and must be able to ride a Bicycle / Motorcycle.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 44 years as on 01/07/2026. SC, ST and BC candidates get 5 years of relaxation, Ex-Service men get 3 years plus their armed forces service, and disabled persons get 10 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of an AYUSH Medical Officer?
faq.answer: An AYUSH Medical Officer gets a consolidated Rs.40,000/- per month. The Yoga Professional gets Rs.28,000/-, and the Pharmacist and MPW get Rs.15,000/- each.

faq.question: Q6. How is the Psychosocial Counselor paid?
faq.answer: The Psychosocial Counselor is paid @ Rs.500/- per session with atleast 200 visits in a year, on call. A panel of eligible candidates may be empaneled.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Download the form from the official website of Jayashankar Bhupalpally District. Submit it with self-attested certificates, in person or by registered post, to IDOC, Room No:G5, Ground Floor, O/o. the Collector & District Magistrate, Jayashankar Bhupalpally District.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: Selection is on 100 marks: 90 for qualifying examination marks (or a written test for MPW) and up to 10 for age, at 0.5 mark per completed year from 18. A merit list will be displayed on the website.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The posts are on an outsourcing basis up to 31.03.2027. After that, services continue as per need and subject to satisfactory performance.

faq.question: Q10. Can an AYUSH Medical Officer apply in other districts?
faq.answer: Yes. The AYUSH Medical Officer is a Multi Zonal cadre post with 95% local reservation. A candidate can apply in any district in the concerned Multi Zone, but selection is restricted to one district.
